sources.title: GitHub - Tsotchke-Corporation/GeoRefine: Bit-exact model codec ...
sources.snippet: GeoRefine TBE stores pretrained BF16 weights in a reversible encoded format and serves them without keeping a dense copy of every coded weight resident. This repository contains the Apache-2.0 codec, runtime, verifier, and tests. Model weights live in the Tsotchke Corporation Qwen3.8-27B TBE model repository.
